messages:
natalie: Heads-up: external assessor wants a short verification run only for RBAC + presigned evidence ingest. Need owners and a minimal bundle by tomorrow noon. Who can take what? :clipboard:
sam: I can own RBAC snapshot + role. Will create `pt-assessor-readonly` with exact prefix permissions and timebound to 3h. No wildcard resources.
kevin: I'll do presigned URLs + KMS grant. Will scope to `assessor_184321/` prefix and require SSE. Will post presign examples here.
emma: I'll pick up vuln-501 (improper ACL on debug logs). Quick PR incoming, will include reproduction steps.
natalie: Suggested retest slot: Fri 09:00-12:00 PT. Ops?@ops-bot mark tentative.
ops-bot: Tentative slot recorded: Fri 09:00-12:00 PT. Confirm 24h prior.
assessor-bot: Assessor requires manifest.json (sha256 checksums), and a roles export. Prefer presigned PUTs for large logs.
kevin: Example presign curl: ```curl -X PUT "<presigned_url>" -T logs.tgz -H "x-amz-meta-checksum:sha256:<sha256>" -H "x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms"``` I'll lock the ACLs so only presigned PUTs work (no ListBucket).
sam: RBAC export command: `rbacctl export --format=flat --out=roles_184321.txt`. I'll also add a short delegation diagram in plain text for the assessor.
emma: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/812 fixing vuln-501. Contains test and `aws s3api get-object-acl` verification steps.
kevin: Ownership summary: KMS/presigns = kevin; RBAC snapshot/role = sam; vuln fixes = emma; retest scheduling = natalie. I'll post presigned links 24h before.
natalie: Please include `thread_ts:1843214321` in PR descriptions so we can trace. Also ensure CloudTrail has AssumeRole events exported for the session window.
kevin: Will tag assessor sessions with `Assessor=184321` so CloudTrail filter is straightforward.
emma: Will add test output to PR and link it here.
sam: One more: manifest must list redactions if any and justify why. Keep hashes for everything.
natalie: Thanks team. We'll reconvene 24h out to confirm final bundle. :white_check_mark:
